arxiv-2109-03864.title: Multi-frequency telecom fibered laser system for potassium laser cooling
arxiv-2109-03864.creator: Charbel Cherfan, Maxime Denis, Denis Bacquet, Michel Gamot, Samir Zemmouri, Isam Manai, Jean-François Clément, Jean-Claude Garreau, Pascal Szriftgiser, Radu Chicireanu
arxiv-2109-03864.description: Abstract We describe a compact and versatile multi-frequency laser system for laser-cooling potassium atoms, by frequency doubling a fiber-optic telecom beam ( ≃ 1534 \simeq 1534 or 1540 1540 nm). Low-power fiber-based telecom lasers and components generate a single beam containing the cooling and repumper half frequencies, subsequently amplified by high-power amplifier.

arxiv-2207-14344.title: Towards virtual access of adaptive optics telemetry data
arxiv-2207-14344.creator: Tiago Gomes, Carlos Correia, Lisa Bardou, Olivier Beltramo-Martin, Thierry Fusco, Caroline Kulcsár, Timothy Morris, Nuno Morujão, Benoît Neichel, James Osborn, Paulo Garcia
arxiv-2207-14344.description: Abstract Large amounts of Adaptive-Optics (AO) control loop data and telemetry are currently inaccessible to end-users. Broadening access to those data has the potential to change the AO landscape on many fronts, addressing several use-cases such as derivation of the system’s PSF, turbulence characterisation and optimisation of system control.

arxiv-2208-03893.title: Category 𝒪 \mathcal{O} for the Lie algebra of vector fields on the line
arxiv-2208-03893.creator: Genqiang Liu and Mingjie Li
arxiv-2208-03893.description: Abstract . Let 𝔚 \mathfrak{W} be the Lie algebra of vector fields on the line. Via computing extensions between all simple modules in the category 𝒪 \mathcal{O} , we give the block decomposition of 𝒪 \mathcal{O} , and show that the representation type of each block of 𝒪 \mathcal{O} is wild using the Ext-quiver.

arxiv-2301-04052.title: Optimal social security timing
arxiv-2301-04052.creator: A.Y. Aydemir
arxiv-2301-04052.description: Abstract The optimal age that a retiree claims social security retirement benefits is in general a complicated function of many factors. However, if the beneficiary’s finances and health are not the constraining factors, it is possible to formally derive mathematical models that maximize a well-defined measure of his total benefits.

arxiv-2307-09512.title: Dissipative phase transitions and passive error correction
arxiv-2307-09512.creator: Yu-Jie Liu, Simon Lieu
arxiv-2307-09512.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yu-Jie Liu, Simon Lieu. We classify different ways to passively protect classical and quantum information, i.e. we do not allow for syndrome measurements, in the context of local Lindblad models for spin systems. Within this family of models, we suggest that passive error correction is associated with nontrivial phases of matter and propose a definition for dissipative phases based on robust steady state degeneracy of a Lindbladian in the thermodynamic limit.

arxiv-2311-04994.title: On the number of subdirect products involving semigroups of integers and natural numbers Thanks: The third author acknowledges support from EPSRC EP/V003224/1.
arxiv-2311-04994.creator: Ashley Clayton, Catherine Reilly, Nik Ruškuc
arxiv-2311-04994.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ashley Clayton, Catherine Reilly, Nik Ruškuc. We extend a recent result that for the (additive) semigroup of positive integers ℕ \mathbb{N} , there are continuum many subdirect products of ℕ × ℕ \mathbb{N}\times\mathbb{N} up to isomorphism. We prove that for U , V U,V each one of ℤ \mathbb{Z} (the group of integers), ℕ 0 \mathbb{N}_{0} (the monoid of non-negative integers), or ℕ \mathbb{N} , the direct product U × V U\times V contains continuum many (semigroup) subdirect products up to isomorphism.

arxiv-2512-14918.title: Inverse semigroup of metrics on a double is fundamental
arxiv-2512-14918.creator: V. Manuilov
arxiv-2512-14918.description: Abstract . We show that the inverse group of equivalence classes of metrics on two copies of a metric space is fundamental. In [ 2 ] we have shown that the set M(X) of equivalence classes of metrics on two copies of a metric space X has a rigid algebraic structure of an inverse semigroup. This, already, was unexpected.

pmc-10701874.title: Optimization Method of Three-Dimensional Equilibrium Displacement in Thin Interbed Reservoirs
pmc-10701874.creator: Bin Jiang, Shiqing Cheng, Kang Ma, Qiao Guo
pmc-10701874.description: Most thin interbed reservoirs face a common problem that a nonequilibrium injection and production relationship in plane and vertical directions results in quick water breakthrough, rapid water-cut rise, and a poor water flooding efficiency in a single layer. A finer injection-production strategy should be developed to avoid serious water channeling and an ineffective water cycle.

pmc-11312480.title: Gastrointestinal and Hepatobiliary Manifestations Associated with Untreated Celiac Disease in Adults and Children: A Narrative Overview
pmc-11312480.creator: Herbert Wieser, Carolina Ciacci, Carlo Soldaini, Carolina Gizzi, Antonella Santonicola
pmc-11312480.description: Celiac disease (CeD) is a chronic inflammatory disease of the small intestine, produced by ingesting dietary gluten products in susceptible people. Gluten causes an impairment of the mucosal surface and, consequently, an abnormal absorption of nutrients. Although malabsorption of essential nutrients is a major risk factor for various CeD-associated morbidities, genetic, immunological, and environmental factors also play an important role.

pmc-11341035.title: Quantifying salinity in calcareous soils through advanced spectroscopic models: A comparative study of random forests and regression techniques across diverse land use systems
pmc-11341035.creator: Mohammad Tahmoures, Afshin Honarbakhsh, Sayed Fakhreddin Afzali, Mehdi Nourzadeh Hadad, Yaser Ostovari, Bijay Halder
pmc-11341035.description: Precise prediction of soil salinity using visible, and near-infrared (vis-NIR) spectroscopy is crucial for ensuring food security and effective environmental management. This paper focuses on the precise prediction of soil salinity utilizing visible and near-infrared (vis-NIR) spectroscopy, a critical factor for food security and effective environmental management.

pmc-11344498.title: Cohort profile: The Aboriginal Families Study – a prospective cohort of Aboriginal children and their mothers and caregivers in South Australia
pmc-11344498.creator: Karen Glover, Cathy Leane, Arwen Nikolof, Deirdre Gartland, Petrea Cahir, Fiona K Mensah, Rebecca Giallo, Sheena Reilly, Philippa Middleton, Maria Makrides, Theresa Francis, Amanda Collins-Clinch, Yvonne Clark, Graham Gee, Stephanie Janne Brown
pmc-11344498.description: AbstractPurposeThe Aboriginal Families Study is a prospective, intergenerational cohort study with well-established Aboriginal governance arrangements and community partnerships to support all research processes including data collection, interpretation and knowledge translation.Participants344 Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander children born in South Australia between July 2011 and June 2013 and their mothers and other primary caregivers.

pmc-11429124.title: Impact of Mild COVID-19 History on Oral-Gut Microbiota and Serum Metabolomics in Adult Patients with Crohn’s Disease: Potential Beneficial Effects
pmc-11429124.creator: Bingjie Xiang, Qi Zhang, Huibo Wu, Jue Lin, Zhaoyuan Xu, Min Zhang, Lixin Zhu, Jun Hu, Min Zhi, Yoshinori Nagai, John K Triantafillidis
pmc-11429124.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The impact of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) history on Crohn’s disease (CD) is unknown. This investigation aimed to examine the effect of COVID-19 history on the disease course, oral-gut microbiota, and serum metabolomics in patients with CD.

pmc-11498708.title: News source bias and sentiment on social media
pmc-11498708.creator: Brian Knutson, Tiffany W. Hsu, Michael Ko, Jeanne L. Tsai, Silvio Eduardo Alvarez Candido, Silvio Eduardo Alvarez Candido, Silvio Eduardo Alvarez Candido
pmc-11498708.description: As social media becomes a key channel for news consumption and sharing, proliferating partisan and mainstream news sources must increasingly compete for users’ attention. While affective qualities of news content may promote engagement, it is not clear whether news source bias influences affective content production or virality, or whether any differences have changed over time.

pmc-12735347.title: Ductile Fracture of L360QS Pipeline Steel Under Multi-Axial Stress States
pmc-12735347.creator: Hong Zheng, Bin Jia, Li Zhu, Naixian Li, Youcai Xiang, Jianfeng Lu, Shiqi Zhang, Alexander Yu Churyumov
pmc-12735347.description: L360QS pipeline steel, due to its high toughness, high strength, resistance to sulfide stress cracking, and resistance to hydrogen-induced cracking, is increasingly being used in pipeline network construction. Its fracture behavior is a critical factor for safe operation in mountainous steep-slope environments, but it has not yet been widely studied.

pmc-12997374.title: Bioinspired hybrid optimisation and deep belief neural networks for early chronic kidney disease detection: an explainable clinical AI framework
pmc-12997374.creator: Zohaib Ahmad, Waeal J. Obidallah, Muhammad Shafiq, Mubarak Albathan, Riyad Almakki, Zeyad Alshaikh, Anas Bilal
pmc-12997374.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The early detection of chronic kidney disease (CKD) can lead to timely and appropriate clinical intervention. However, most CKD diagnostic systems rely on redundant features and provide unreliable results in small and unbalanced datasets. Therefore, it is challenging to apply them in clinical settings due to a lack of transparency, as well as the extensive amount of time and effort to fine-tune them using manual labor.

pmc-13127130.title: Virtual medicine: medical AI in human health and diseases
pmc-13127130.creator: Chen Zhang, Fu-Xiao Wang, Xuan Tang, Ji-Long Li, Ning Ding, Yang Hong, Pei-Ran Song, Long Bai, Jia-Can Su
pmc-13127130.description: The evolution of medicine has progressed through distinct ages: from empirical observation and evidence-based practice to the current era of precision medicine. However, traditional healthcare paradigms remain constrained by data fragmentation, scalability limits, and the overwhelming complexity of multi-omics integration. In the rapid explosion of artificial intelligence (AI), a transformative paradigm is emerging.

pmc-13352086.title: A silent culprit: Prosthetic valve endocarditis due to Cutibacterium acnes
pmc-13352086.creator: Dhan Bahadur Shrestha, Ruvarashe Mupedziswa, Jeyavishnupriya Gopalkrishnan, Daniel Katz
pmc-13352086.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cutibacterium acnes is an infrequent cause of infective endocarditis, mainly affecting patients with prosthetic valves. It’s unusual and slow-developing clinical presentation often leads to misdiagnosis as culture-negative endocarditis, causing delayed or inadequate treatment and worse outcomes. We report a man in his early fifties with a history of bicuspid aortic valve with prior surgical replacement due to group B streptococcal endocarditis, who presented to outpatient cardiology with one week of worsening shortness of breath. His ischemic evaluation was unremarkable.

pmc-13355472.title: Two cases of traumatic aortic isthmus pseudoaneurysm successfully managed with endovascular repair: Multidisciplinary critical care and anesthetic perspective
pmc-13355472.creator: Mohammed Taloubi, Iman Zahrou, Saley M.M. Rabilou, Mohammed Chafi, Lamya A. Sayad, Ghizlane E. Aidouni, Houssam Bkiyar
pmc-13355472.description: Blunt thoracic aortic injury (BTAI) is a rare but life-threatening consequence of high-energy trauma, most commonly involving the aortic isthmus. Contrast-enhanced computed tomography is essential for rapid diagnosis and therapeutic planning. Thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR) has become the preferred treatment in hemodynamically stable patients because of its lower perioperative morbidity compared with open surgery.

pmc-13440101.creator: Liantian Chen, Jinjing Fu, Xueqing Jia, Liming Zhang, Xinli Jin, Shuhui Wu, Bin Zhu, Kaili Sun, Duoduo Fu, Yanyan Wang, Zuyun Liu, Shimin Li, Jingyun Zhang
pmc-13440101.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to examine the associations between insomnia trajectories and the risk of incident cognitive impairment, as well as to evaluate whether immune cell subsets mediate these associations.MethodsA total of 6,316 participants aged 50 years or older from the Health and Retirement Study (HRS) were included in this prospective cohort study.

uslaw-usc-t25-s123c.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 4 (Performance By United States Of Obligations To Indians); Subchapter II (Disbursement Of Moneys And Supplies). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. On and after October 12, 1984, tribal funds may be advanced to Indian tribes during each fiscal year for such purposes as may be designated by the governing body of the particular tribe involved.
